steps.text: Start at Therapies.
Go straight on.
Follow the Hospital Street corridor in front of you. We are going to walk its entire length.
You pass Therapy reception and the Patient Lounge on your right.
Keep going and walk straight through the West Wing Lift Lobby.
Keep going straight. You pass the Feast Restaurant on your right.
Walk on to the East Wing Lift Lobby and straight through it.
Follow this corridor to a right turn.
Turn right and follow the corridor to its end. On your left is the Hub Garden.
At the T junction, the main Oncology entrance is in front of you. Enter here.
Walk through the waiting room, past reception on your left.
Go through the double doors. The lift lobby is immediately on your left.
Take the lift down to Level A.
Exit the lift and turn left. Walk straight, out of the lift lobby.
Turn left and walk straight, through a corridor, then through a waiting area with a hidden garden view.
After the waiting area, take the first corridor on your left.
Take the second right, signposted Radiotherapy reception.
You have arrived at Radiotherapy.
steps.note: Report to reception and check in with the team.
